descriptor.scene: The finished line, working. A wide view along the whole workbench showing all five hand-made machines standing in their row in process order, with the throwing arm at the far LEFT end beside the open doorway. All three of them are busy at different points along it: Tomas at the near right end feeding a fresh sheet into the little felt-fingered machine, Mira mid-bench at the CLEAR OPEN STRETCH of bare bench folding a plane by hand, and Pip a little further along working a crease with both hands. A finished plane is in the cradle of the arm at the far end. The room is small, wooden, cluttered and warm and must NEVER read as a laboratory or a factory floor. Every plane visible in the frame is a different fold.
